I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm: Dock 38 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on.

I didn't save it to my persistent memory. That memory loads into every session, including other members' conversations, and rule 2 says what a member tells me in a DM can't be carried into anyone else's conversation. So the note lives only in Dana's DM with me, and I'll use it when Dana asks.
